rca of the issue: RCA-1: `vehicle_timeout` appears to originate from VehicleDetails Promise-based fetch path (chunk lines near async Promise.all), likely a timeout guard for non-critical data that still logs as error during print interaction. Repro: open target vehicle page, click visit-print-button, observe console. Mitigation: downgrade non-critical timeout to warn/debug or gate it from user-triggered print path. RCA-2: DOM nesting warning root cause is structural: visit card header uses button wrapper (`visit-card-toggle-*`) while containing another button (`visit-print-button-*`), violating HTML interactive-content nesting rules. Mitigation: change outer wrapper to div with role/button keyboard handlers, or move inner print trigger outside toggle button.
